source_review.canonical_publication: 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census Analytical Report on Disability

verified_findings: KNBS publishes the canonical Atlas disability-prevalence values at county level in KPHC Analytical Report on Disability Table 2.13.
KNBS KeNADA exposes the 2019 KPHC study metadata and documentation as an official census study for individuals and households.

Official 2019 KPHC questionnaire material contains constituency and ward geography fields, so child-domain feasibility cannot be rejected solely because the currently ingested published table is county-level.

The publicly inspectable KeNADA study page does not itself expose a verified child-level disability-prevalence table or enough variable/file detail to demonstrate that a reproducible constituency/ward extract matching the Atlas definition can be produced safely.

KNBS published census result tables reviewed for this gate describe administrative-unit and socio-economic releases, but no governed current-290 constituency or 1,450-ward disability-prevalence table matching Table 2.13 was identified.

required_before_materialization: Obtain an official KNBS constituency/ward disability tabulation using the same Washington Group threshold and denominator as the canonical Atlas measure, or obtain authorised/public microdata with usable child geography identifiers.
Verify the exact disability variables, denominator semantics, geography codes and disclosure constraints.
Reproduce the published 47-county Table 2.13 values from any proposed microdata transformation before publishing lower-level observations.
Reconcile source geography to the Atlas 290 constituencies and 1,450 wards; any boundary mismatch must remain an explicit spatial hold rather than be silently crosswalked.

recommended_next_action: Request or locate an official KNBS child-level tabulation or verified KeNADA microdata extract; until that evidence is available, leave IND-DISABILITY-PREVALENCE child rows as review_required and continue P23X with another independently reviewable indicator.
